title: Regulation E Error Resolution Timetable for the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account
content:
The Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account handles errors under Regulation E within the following periods. Every plan (Paystride Visa Payroll Card Essential, Standard, Select, Advantage, Premier, Elite) has its own column.

| | Essential | Standard | Select | Advantage | Premier | Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Error notice window after the history access date, calendar days | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Outer limit for an error notice after the disputed transaction's posted date, calendar days | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 |
| Investigation, business days from the notice date | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Investigation of a new-account transaction, business days | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Extended investigation, calendar days after the notice date | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Extended investigation for a new-account, point-of-sale or foreign-initiated transaction, calendar days | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Provisional credit, business days from the notice date | 10 | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Written confirmation of an oral notice, business days | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Result reported after the investigation ends, business days | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Wait before a provisional credit reversal posts, business days after the resolution date | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| New-account period, calendar days after the first deposit date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Final credit after an error is found, business days | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

## Day-counting conventions

Calendar days are every day of the calendar. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays. The Federal Reserve holidays that fall on a weekday in the years 2025 to 2028 are:

- **2025:** 1 January, 20 January, 17 February, 26 May, 19 June, 4 July, 1 September, 13 October, 11 November, 27 November, 25 December.
- **2026:** 1 January, 19 January, 16 February, 25 May, 19 June, 7 September, 12 October, 11 November, 26 November, 25 December.
- **2027:** 1 January, 18 January, 15 February, 31 May, 5 July, 6 September, 11 October, 11 November, 25 November.
- **2028:** 17 January, 21 February, 29 May, 19 June, 4 July, 4 September, 9 October, 23 November, 25 December.

## Hypothetical illustration

Take a notice given on a Tuesday, in a week and the following week with no holiday. On the Advantage, Premier and Elite plans, a provisional credit within 5 business days of that notice falls on or before the following Tuesday. On the Essential, Standard and Select plans the 10 business days run to the Tuesday a week after that.
